parsed.summary: Tracing power, the FCC/NAVC UART2+I2C+GPIO link, the I2C address map (INA219 0x40, PCA9685 0x41, EEPROM 0x50, sensor set 0x18/0x19/0x1E/0x4E/0x69 all distinct per bus), the buck feedback (R5/R6 giving ~5 V) and the 3V3 LDO, the drawing matches the specification. The only apparent deviations (barometer RESET/EOC swap, PCA9685 at 0x41 vs the spec table's 0x40, GPS fed from 3V3 vs the spec's '5 V', and the duplicated I2C alternate-pin labels) are either explicitly documented as known reference-design bugs or are corrections/harmless alternate-pin connections that keep the board behaving as intended, so no anomaly is reported.
